description: Horaires en temps réel des transports en commun Naolib de Nantes Métropole (API Json) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Semitan. The API allows the following operations to be carried out: List stops (nearby or not) Obtain waiting time at a stop zone Retrieve schedules at a stop The API only returns the next 1 to 2 passes in real time. The return format is JSON. Coverage: Semitan. The portal shows the English title as "Real-time timetables for public transport Naolib de Nantes Métropole (API Json)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Semitan. Its keywords include deplacement, transport-en-commun, naolib, mobilite, temps-reel. The listing shows 3 download or service links in PDF, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2012-04-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
